snippet.title: I'm Making a Monster - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Try to build a monster while your friends bother you to take breaks. In I'm Making a Monster, you play as a mage/scientist and decide how to prioritize your time as you construct the monster. This short interactive narrative is part monster-dress-up game, part friend-dating simulator, and all how-not-to-deal-with-loss advice column. Delve into creative obsession, grief, and magical realism in a warm, melancholic world. Will you fall into despair or climb back out of the well?

Wishlist it on Steam today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047160/Im_Making_a_Monster/


The text in the trailer:
- Ofir Sonnet has been shut in their room for a month.
- Today, Ofir opens the door to their room. They fumble for a scrap piece of paper and tear the lid off a pen.
- Fervor and ink splatter onto page after page in unsteady strokes.
- Abella's brow wrinkles. "It's warm out today. How about we go for a walk?"
- "The flowers are blooming. Why don't you come see them with me?" asks Luxme.
- Corey sighs. "You can't stay shut in your lab forever."
- But Ofir doesn't waver from their work.
